blocks.text: Agent provisioning keys are created during agent group configuration. You can edit or delete provisioning keys as needed outside agent group configuration.
To delete an agent provisioning key:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agent Groups and select an agent group.
On the Provisioning Keys tab, click the Delete icon for the provisioning key you want to delete.
The Delete Provisioning Key window appears.

blocks.text: The page refreshes and removes the agent provisioning key from the list.
